source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with hazy distant hills, riverbank reeds, a moored boat, small riverside dwellings, a lone walking fisherman/scholar figure, foreground rocks, bare branches, and a rustic gate or small pavilion element. Calligraphy/seals/borders excluded.

motifs.name: misty_distant_hills
motifs.description: Layered distant mountain and hillside silhouettes across the upper half, fading into atmospheric mist; isolate only the soft horizontal ridgelines and pale ink washes, excluding birds and reeds on the right.
must_preserve: subtle tonal transitions from darker left ridge to paler central hills

motifs.name: flying_geese_flock
motifs.description: Small flock of dark birds/geese flying diagonally in the upper-right sky, separated from surrounding reeds and hills.
must_preserve: crisp ink marks against open sky

motifs.name: upper_reed_bank_with_boat
motifs.description: Sloping upper-right reed bank with a narrow moored boat partly hidden among grasses; include the hull, dark cabin-like bundle, upright posts, and dense crossing reed strokes, excluding distant hills and lower rocks.
must_preserve: dark ink mass on stern or covered cargo

motifs.name: midground_village_cluster
motifs.description: Small riverside village or hut cluster on the left midground shore with low rounded roofs, nearby bank marks, and short vertical fence/reed strokes reflected near water.
must_preserve: dark accent dots on roof ridges

motifs.name: central_walking_fisherman
motifs.description: Lone standing/walking figure carrying a long fishing pole over the shoulder; include hat/head, robe folds, bare legs, sandals, dangling basket or gear, and the full diagonal pole.
must_preserve: fine contour linework of robe and limbs
bundle or basket hanging at side
ink accents on head and clothing folds

motifs.name: central_rocky_slope_reeds
motifs.description: Central sloping earthen bank and rock outcrop behind the figure, with dark boulders, dry-brush texture, and right-side reed thickets; exclude the figure and upper boat as much as possible.
must_preserve: dark rock contours and interior texture strokes
thin reed blades crossing the right edge
soft waterline washes below the rocks

motifs.name: foreground_twisted_tree_rock
motifs.description: Large foreground left gnarled tree/root and rock formation with bare angular branches and clustered shrubs at its base; isolate from the central figure and lower-right rocks.
must_preserve: heavy shaded rock base with pale exposed edges

motifs.name: lower_right_gate_rocks_reeds
motifs.description: Lower-right foreground rustic gate or small wooden structure beside boulders and reeds; include vertical posts, dark roof/beam strokes, adjacent large rock, grasses, and shoreline textures.
must_preserve: dark broken roof or beam accents
large faceted boulder with ink texture
clusters of thin reeds and grasses

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
